scope: All 135 JPEG photos in this source image folder; the nine MP4 videos are cataloged separately in video-index.json.
quality_scale: Subjective visual appeal, composition, lighting, clarity and visible technical quality; higher is better. Scores assess the photograph, never a person.
method: Each oriented photo was visually reviewed individually at up to 1400 pixels on the long edge, alongside contact-sheet comparisons and original dimensions. No crops or edits were used to assign the scores.
preservation: Filenames only: original file bytes, embedded metadata and dimensions are unchanged. Duplicate copies retained.
